summary: The discussion proposes setting up the first Spark community sync on Nov 30, 2026, with a 50‑minute agenda covering recent changes, SPIPs, release status, and an open floor. Serge Rielau proposes a new SQL data type, OBJECT, that matches structured fields by name rather than position, addressing the current limitations of STRUCT. The discussion centers on a proposal to broaden Spark’s Data Source V2 push-down capabilities to include full outer, semi, anti joins, alias tolerance, set operations, and window functions. Participants debate which join types are worth supporting and whether the new features should be enabled by default, while noting that the reference implementation targets JDBC/H2 and does not cover cross-source push-down.
